name: Zara
description: Driscoll's strawberry variety sold in the UK under the Driscoll's brand and, separately, retailer own-label packaging (e.g. Tesco's 'British Zara Strawberries'). Named the Guardian's 'best overall supermarket strawberry' in a 2026 taste test of 10 major UK retailers' strawberries. Real, multi-source-confirmed commercial name; no plant-patent or PVR filing has been linked yet (added for the Variety Intelligence Backbone V1 mission's UK retail observation pilot, 2026-08-21, not from a registry filing).
